'''Kassa''' was the first [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Binary star/Legends|binary stars]] [[Adega Prime]] and [[Adega Besh]] in the [[Adega system/Legends|Adega system]].<ref name="GW" /><ref name="EA" /> Located in the [[Auril sector/Legends|Auril sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion<ref name="Region" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], Kassa was a [[Temperature/Legends|searing]] rock orbited by no [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="GW" /><ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Adega system/Legends|Adega system]], except [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], were first introduced in the [[2004]] sourcebook ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''.<ref name="GW" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Adega star system in grid square R-6.<ref name="EA" />
